name: lichen_moor
theme: a dusk moor of standing stones where one weathered stone reads as a world from orbit, its lichen crusts standing in for continents; the dive drops through the lichen's stalk forest into the fracture network inside the rock, and that same branching network opens back out as the dry-stone walls dividing the moor

registers.name: moor_ridge
registers.palette: deep heather purple and dusk vermilion
registers.scene: a wide dusk moor seen from high above, dark heather flats and black peat pools reaching to the horizon, dry-stone walls running in a rough branching network over the slopes and dividing the ground into uneven fields, a rutted track threading between them, low mist lying in the hollows, a ring of rough stones set on the high ground, empty, no one present
registers.target: a tall leaning standing stone, rough grey granite

registers.name: stone_ring
registers.palette: cool grey stone and violet mist
registers.scene: a ring of standing stones on the moor top at eye level, seven rough granite pillars ranged around a floor of cropped turf, each one leaning at its own angle, violet mist lying low between them, crusted patches of orange and sage on their weathered sides, the last dusk light bright in the gaps, empty, no one present
registers.target: a broad rounded stone, grey and weathered

registers.name: stone_world
registers.palette: rust orange and sage green on grey, deep indigo behind
registers.scene: a great rounded weathered stone set against the deep indigo dusk, its curved edge lit along one side, broad rust-orange and pale sage crusts spread over the grey rock, their margins broken into ragged fingers and notches, dark bare channels winding between them, a dust of pale flecks scattered through the whole

registers.name: lichen_crust
registers.scene: a rust-orange lichen crust spread across pale grey stone seen from straight above, ragged overlapping plates meeting along their edges, small dark discs scattered over them, hairline grey channels dividing the crust into irregular islands, pale sage-green tufts standing at the rims
registers.target: a pale sage-green tuft, branched and spongy
registers.loop_target: a rust-orange lichen crust on pale grey stone, ragged plates and scattered dark discs

registers.name: thallus_forest
registers.scene: a forest of lichen stalks standing up from the crust, pale sage-green trunks rising in dense ranks, each one flattened and forked at its top, deep shaded gaps running between them, fine grey dust caught along the stems, the pale rock floor showing far below
registers.target: a bright emerald bead, round and glossy

registers.name: algal_weave
registers.scene: the packed weave inside a lichen stalk, pale amber threads braided in every direction, clusters of round emerald beads set among them, warm light coming through the spongy tangle, and under it all a floor of bare pale rock crossed by dark hairline cracks

registers.name: crack_lattice
registers.palette: pale grey stone and rust stain
registers.scene: a branching network of hairline cracks running through pale grey stone, the fractures dividing the rock into irregular flat islands of every size, some paths crossing clear from one side to the other and others closing in blind loops, rust-orange stain seeping along the wider cracks, tiny mineral grains glinting in the flats

music_theme: a windswept dusk moor of old stones, low drone and a slow skin-drum pulse under airy strings, one bright swell landing where the cracked rock opens out into the walled moor
